children: Our Bureau New Delhi: The Centre will cautiously weigh Adani Group's proposal for starting an airline despite its endeavour to break the dominance of IndiGo and Air India in the domestic market, civil aviation minister Ram Mohan Naidu said Tuesday.

The government is wary about the conflict of interest Adani's entry into the aviation business may cause in terms of cross ownership of airlines and airports, said Naidu, responding to a query from ET. "When an airport operator wants to operate an airline, we also have to examine the potential disadvantages," he said. "We need to create a system that addresses those concerns. There are several advantages, but the matter is under deliberation."

title: 'Govt to Cautiously Weigh Adani's Airline Proposal'
